notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): MSUI has a right-click unit popup (Program.UnitPopup.cs) opened from party-frame and world right-clicks, but it is a small fixed 4-row card: Trade (CMSG_INITIATE_TRADE), Follow (permanently disabled stub), Inspect (with InspectUiLaw distance/eligibility gating), Cancel. Benilla's UnitPopup.xml transcribes the whole 1.12 menu system over the dropdown kit: SELF/PARTY/PLAYER/RAID menus with Whisper, Invite/Uninvite/Promote, Duel, Leave Party, loot-method + loot-threshold submenus, working Follow, interact-distance graying, 5s timeout.
